Since 1957

Pioneering Excellence in Physical Education

Established in the centenary year of the First War of Independence, LNIPE Gwalior stands as a tribute to Rani Lakshmibai. Founded under the leadership of Padma Shri Dr. P.M. Joseph, it is the only Deemed University in India dedicated exclusively to Physical Education and Sports.

Deemed University Status

Recognized under UGC Act, maintaining highest academic standards.

Awards & Recognition

ISO Certified Institution.

World-Class Campus

153-acre lush green campus with Olympic-standard facilities.
